summary: Heading colors were updated consistently to blue across the page, but the contact info paragraph text was inadvertently changed from white to dark blue, likely resulting in contrast/legibility issues against a dark background.

regressions.explanation: The text color for the contact information paragraph changed from white (rgb(255, 255, 255)) to dark blue (rgb(30, 64, 175)). This appears to be an unintended CSS rule leak affecting white text on dark background containers.
